name: The Cochin Malabar Estates And Industries Limited
summary: Cochin Malabar Estates & Industries Ltd. specializes in the cultivation, processing, and sale of tea, rubber, and a variety of other agricultural products. The company also operates in the field of fire engineering from its Mumbai location and manages an aquaculture farm in Goa for the breeding of tiger prawns and shrimp. It was established on March 14, 1930, with its corporate headquarters located in Kolkata, India.
